parameters.content:
## v1/ocr-search/index

Reads already-extracted OCR text directly from SQL Server
(Docs_Record -> Docs_DocumentInfo -> Docs_AttachmentsInfo -> OcrResultInfo,
OcrResultInfo.AttachmentId = Docs_AttachmentsInfo.MongoDbId) and
indexes it into Qdrant, one page = one chunk. No file upload, no
content-extraction-service -- the text already exists in the DB.

VERIFY the real dbo table names in the SQL node before running --
they're assumed from the CSV export names.

Optional body field: document_id (UUID) -- re-index just one
document instead of the full table. Omit for a full sync.

Purely additive: re-running does NOT delete old points for the
same document first. Ask if you want delete-before-insert added.

prepare chunk metadata now also strips embedded HTML (e.g. pasted
<table> markup) out of chunk_content before it's embedded/indexed --
tables are flattened to readable "label | value" lines.

parameters.query:
SELECT
    ocr.Id AS ocr_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ocr.MarkDownResultText, '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, ocr.Result COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS page_text,
    ocr.PageNo AS page_no,
    att.Id AS attachment_id,
    att.AttachmentName AS attachment_name,
    att.TotalPages AS total_pages,

    doc.Id AS document_id,
    doc.NameAr AS document_name_ar,
    doc.NameEn AS document_name_en,
    doc.DocumentNo AS document_no,
    doc.DocumentDate AS document_date,
    doc.ContentKeyWords AS content_keywords,
    doc.SecurityLevelId AS document_security_level_id,
    doc.ImportanceLevelId AS document_importance_level_id,
    doc.MainDocTypeId AS document_main_doc_type_id,
    doc.SecondaryDocTypeId AS document_secondary_doc_type_id,
    doc.StatusLookupId AS document_status_id,
    doc.TextTypeId AS document_text_type_id,
    doc.AssetTypeId AS document_asset_type_id,
    doc.MaterialTypeId AS document_material_type_id,
    doc.SubjectId AS document_subject_id,

    docsec.Name_Ar AS document_security_level_name_ar,
    docsec.Name_Eng AS document_security_level_name_en,
    docimp.NameAr AS document_importance_level_name_ar,
    docmaintype.NameAr AS document_main_doc_type_name_ar,
    docmaintype.NameEn AS document_main_doc_type_name_en,
    docsubtype.Name AS document_secondary_doc_type_name,
    docstatus.Name_Ar AS document_status_name_ar,
    docstatus.Name_En AS document_status_name_en,
    doctexttype.NameAr AS document_text_type_name_ar,
    doctexttype.NameEn AS document_text_type_name_en,
    docassettype.NameAr AS document_asset_type_name_ar,
    docassettype.NameEn AS document_asset_type_name_en,
    docmaterial.Name_Ar AS document_material_type_name_ar,
    docmaterial.Name_Eng AS document_material_type_name_en,
    docsubject.Subject_Name_Ar AS document_subject_name_ar,
    docsubject.Subject_Name_En AS document_subject_name_en,

    rec.Id AS record_id,
    rec.NameAr AS record_name_ar,
    rec.NameEng AS record_name_en,
    rec.ReferenceNo AS reference_no,
    rec.TreatmentDate AS treatment_date,
    rec.SecurityLevelId AS record_security_level_id,
    rec.ImportantLevelId AS record_important_level_id,
    rec.DepartmentId AS record_department_id,
    rec.SubjectId AS record_subject_id,

    recsec.Name_Ar AS record_security_level_name_ar,
    recsec.Name_Eng AS record_security_level_name_en,
    recimp.NameAr AS record_important_level_name_ar,
    recdept.Dept_Name_Ar AS record_department_name_ar,
    recdept.Dept_Name_En AS record_department_name_en,
    recsubject.Subject_Name_Ar AS record_subject_name_ar,
    recsubject.Subject_Name_En AS record_subject_name_en

-- Relationship: Record -> DocumentInfo -> AttachmentsInfo -> OcrResultInfo
-- (OcrResultInfo.AttachmentId points at AttachmentsInfo.MongoDbId, not AttachmentsInfo.Id)
FROM dbo.Docs_Record rec
LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_DocumentInfo doc ON rec.Id = doc.Docs_RecordId AND doc.IsDeleted = 0
LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_AttachmentsInfo att ON doc.Id = att.DocumentId AND att.IsDeleted = 0
LEFT JOIN dbo.OcrResultInfo ocr ON ocr.AttachmentId = att.MongoDbId AND ocr.IsDeleted = 0

LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_SecurityLevelLookup docsec ON docsec.Id = doc.SecurityLevelId
LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_ImportanceLevelLookup docimp ON docimp.Id = doc.ImportanceLevelId
LEFT JOIN dbo.DMS_DocumentMainTypes docmaintype ON docmaintype.Id = doc.MainDocTypeId
LEFT JOIN dbo.DMS_DocumentSubTypes docsubtype ON docsubtype.Id = doc.SecondaryDocTypeId
LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_DocumentStatusLookup docstatus ON docstatus.Id = doc.StatusLookupId
LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_DocumentTextType doctexttype ON doctexttype.Id = doc.TextTypeId
LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_DocumentAssetType docassettype ON docassettype.Id = doc.AssetTypeId
LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_MaterialTypeLookup docmaterial ON docmaterial.Id = doc.MaterialTypeId
LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_Subject docsubject ON docsubject.Id = doc.SubjectId

LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_SecurityLevelLookup recsec ON recsec.Id = rec.SecurityLevelId
LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_ImportanceLevelLookup recimp ON recimp.Id = rec.ImportantLevelId
LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_Department recdept ON recdept.Id = rec.DepartmentId
LEFT JOIN dbo.Docs_Subject recsubject ON recsubject.Id = rec.SubjectId

WHERE rec.IsDeleted = 0
  -- only pages that actually have OCR text can be embedded; records/documents/attachments
  -- without an OCR row come through the LEFT JOINs as NULLs and are skipped here
  AND ocr.Id IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(ocr.MarkDownResultText, '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, ocr.Result COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT))), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND ($1 IS NULL OR doc.Id = CAST($1 AS uniqueidentifier))
ORDER BY rec.Id, doc.Id, att.Id, ocr.PageNo

parameters.pythonCode:
import re import html def html_to_text(s): """Strip HTML markup that sometimes shows up inside OCR page text (e.g. Word/HTML tables pasted into the source document), converting it into plain readable text instead of leaving raw tags in what gets embedded and indexed. Tables are flattened one row per line, cells joined with " | ", empty cells dropped. Everything else is just tag-stripped. Non-HTML text (plain OCR / Markdown) passes through basically unchanged. """ if not s: return s # newline before each table row; join cells within a row with " | " s = re.sub(r'(?i)<\s*tr[^>]*>', '\n', s) s = re.sub(r'(?i)<\s*/\s*tr\s*>', '', s) s = re.sub(r'(?i)<\s*/\s*t[dh]\s*>', ' | ', s) s = re.sub(r'(?i)<\s*t[dh][^>]*>', '', s) # table wrapper tags become line breaks s = re.sub(r'(?i)<\s*/?\s*(table|tbody|thead|tfoot)[^>]*>', '\n', s) #
-> newline s = re.sub(r'(?i)<\s*br\s*/?\s*>', '\n', s) #

/

boundaries -> newline (in case any show up) s = re.sub(r'(?i)<\s*/?\s*(p|div)[^>]*>', '\n', s) # drop any remaining tags entirely s = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', s) # decode entities (  etc.) and strip stray BOM/zero-width chars common in OCR HTML s = html.unescape(s) s = s.replace('\ufeff', '') lines = [] for raw_line in s.split('\n'): line = raw_line.strip() line = re.sub(r'^[\s|]+', '', line) # leading empty cells / separators line = re.sub(r'[\s|]+$', '', line) # trailing empty cells / separators line = re.sub(r'\|(\s*\|)+', '|', line) # collapse repeated empty-cell separators line = re.sub(r'[ \t]{2,}', ' ', line) if line: lines.append(line) return '\n'.join(lines) try: output_items = [] for i, it in enumerate(_items): r = it.get('json', {}) or {} output_items.append({ "json": { "chunk_content": html_to_text(r.get('page_text') or ''), "page_no": r.get('page_no'), "attachment_id": r.get('attachment_id'), "attachment_name": r.get('attachment_name'), "total_pages": r.get('total_pages'), "document_id": r.get('document_id'), "document_name_ar": r.get('document_name_ar'), "document_name_en": r.get('document_name_en'), "document_no": r.get('document_no'), "document_date": r.get('document_date'), "content_keywords": r.get('content_keywords'), "document_security_level_id": r.get('document_security_level_id'), "document_security_level_name_ar": r.get('document_security_level_name_ar'), "document_security_level_name_en": r.get('document_security_level_name_en'), "document_importance_level_id": r.get('document_importance_level_id'), "document_importance_level_name_ar": r.get('document_importance_level_name_ar'), "document_main_doc_type_id": r.get('document_main_doc_type_id'), "document_main_doc_type_name_ar": r.get('document_main_doc_type_name_ar'), "document_main_doc_type_name_en": r.get('document_main_doc_type_name_en'), "document_secondary_doc_type_id": r.get('document_secondary_doc_type_id'), "document_secondary_doc_type_name": r.get('document_secondary_doc_type_name'), "document_status_id": r.get('document_status_id'), "document_status_name_ar": r.get('document_status_name_ar'), "document_status_name_en": r.get('document_status_name_en'), "document_text_type_id": r.get('document_text_type_id'), "document_text_type_name_ar": r.get('document_text_type_name_ar'), "document_text_type_name_en": r.get('document_text_type_name_en'), "document_asset_type_id": r.get('document_asset_type_id'), "document_asset_type_name_ar": r.get('document_asset_type_name_ar'), "document_asset_type_name_en": r.get('document_asset_type_name_en'), "document_material_type_id": r.get('document_material_type_id'), "document_material_type_name_ar": r.get('document_material_type_name_ar'), "document_material_type_name_en": r.get('document_material_type_name_en'), "document_subject_id": r.get('document_subject_id'), "document_subject_name_ar": r.get('document_subject_name_ar'), "document_subject_name_en": r.get('document_subject_name_en'), "record_id": r.get('record_id'), "record_name_ar": r.get('record_name_ar'), "record_name_en": r.get('record_name_en'), "reference_no": r.get('reference_no'), "treatment_date": r.get('treatment_date'), "record_security_level_id": r.get('record_security_level_id'), "record_security_level_name_ar": r.get('record_security_level_name_ar'), "record_security_level_name_en": r.get('record_security_level_name_en'), "record_important_level_id": r.get('record_important_level_id'), "record_important_level_name_ar": r.get('record_important_level_name_ar'), "record_department_id": r.get('record_department_id'), "record_department_name_ar": r.get('record_department_name_ar'), "record_department_name_en": r.get('record_department_name_en'), "record_subject_id": r.get('record_subject_id'), "record_subject_name_ar": r.get('record_subject_name_ar'), "record_subject_name_en": r.get('record_subject_name_en') }, "pairedItem": i }) return output_items except Exception as e: print(f"Chunk preparation error: {e}") raise

parameters.content:
## Metadata full-text index (new)

Runs in parallel with the OCR indexing pipeline every time
'do index' fires. Ensures Qdrant has a text payload index on
the metadata fields used by the search workflow's metadata
branch (title, doc/reference no, keywords, record/subject
name), so MatchText filters on those fields work.

Idempotent -- Qdrant recreating an existing index with the
same schema is a harmless no-op.

VERIFY before running:
- QDRANT_BASE_URL / QDRANT_API_KEY in 'index configs'
- that payload fields are actually nested under "metadata.*"
  (matches this project's LangChain Qdrant node defaults --
  confirm by inspecting one point's payload in Qdrant)
- tokenizer choice ("word") for Arabic text -- Qdrant has no
  built-in Arabic stemmer, tune min_token_len/tokenizer if
  recall is poor

nodes.name: create qdrant metadata index
nodes.notes: PUT /collections/{collection}/index -- creates (or re-creates) a text payload index for one metadata field per item
